'''Revessa Global Shipping''' was a large [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]-owned shipping corporation<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> that existed toward the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Crovessk]] was the CEO of the company.
